hooks.name: zero-leak-network-and-secret-guard
hooks.description: Blocks accidental introduction of outbound fetch/analytics calls, hardcoded cloud/Firebase/AI API keys (AIza, ghp_, AKIA, sk-, hf_, ATATT), or private SPA overwrites on save and pre-push.

action.prompt: Audit the saved file against .kiro/steering/product-and-privacy-constitution.md: verify zero outbound fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket calls exist, verify zero hardcoded Google/Firebase (AIza), GitHub (ghp_), AWS (AKIA), OpenAI/Anthropic (sk-), HuggingFace (hf_), or Atlassian (ATATT) secrets or private SPA (_BUILTIN_FB) leaks exist, and auto-remediate before commit/push.
